model.wind_knowledge: Known fixed wind, zero uncertainty; three identical inner fields. Oracle diagnostic, no learned belief.
model.dimensions: Planar x,y translation at the displayed 0.75m slice; horizontal relative air velocity, no vertical/attitude dynamics.
model.reference: C2 cubic interpolant of the existing route guides, 41 arc-length knots; rest-to-rest quintic timing; speed <=1m/s and each acceleration <=0.8m/s^2.
model.tracker: clip(a_ref+1.2*(p_ref-p)+1.8*(v_ref-v),-1.6,1.6); identical in both conditions; no nominal wind compensation.
model.termination: Stop at first swept point contact; otherwise duration+10s. Target-region membership is separate from endpoint error.
model.still_air: Same air-force law with w=0, same nominal tracker, no safety filter.
model.qualification: Conditional diagnostic in the existing provisional CFD fields. Not a physical-wind validation, learned-wind test, or global safety/reachability proof.

directional_authority.qualification: Computed on the prescribed reference. Exceeding the actuator bound rules out exact tracking there; it does not prove that every alternative trajectory is impossible.
